notes: Table 2 antidiabetic-drug-use summary. Keeps the author's two UNION ALL aggregation queries (per drug class, sum of *_user flags over the cohort, divided by the real 3999 / 244115 denominators) and the FULL JOIN that pivots them into one drug_summary table, then PROC PRINTs it. The two DUA-protected source datasets ad.drug_user_with_ad / ad.drug_user_without_ad are stood up in autoexec as small synthetic patient-level tables with identical 0/1 user-flag columns. The closing PROC SGPLOT clustered bar chart from the original script is replaced by PROC PRINT of the same drug_summary table so the bundle produces deterministic listing output.
